rules.join: CISI prefix and integer base number; one Lipi family per number and one table row per family. Multiple face bases or multiple table rows for a family are ambiguous and excluded.
rules.population: Corpus counts include all Lipi families. Joined and volume counts include unique joined families. Families with no table row remain in corpus denominators and their baseline fields remain covered.
rules.before: Inventory usable Lipi excavation-idno and older-export MUSEUM on an identical raw CISI key; museum and institution follow the pilot baseline. FC absent in baseline.
rules.after: Baseline or parser-supplied field. Unknown institution codes are retained without an invented expansion; parser review is required.
rules.brackets: including_brackets counts usable uncertain cells; without_brackets_in_cell excludes any supplied cell containing a square bracket. Each mode filters baseline cells in the same way.
rules.groups: Inventory type_group and site_group; mixed face types form a mixed group, mixed face sites fall in other sites, as in the inventory.
